name: Np_stir_bar_rotating_zone
source: VesselTwin OpenFOAM v2512 rotating-zone (MRF frozen rotor, simpleFoam kEpsilon wall functions), mesh study: tier2/verification/gci.json + tier2/verification/data/flask_np_raw.json, commit see docs/progress/track-b.md
statement: single-point values at Re = 4636 and Re = 9271 (two points, water 25 C, 100 mL flask at fill 0.5 modelled as equal-volume cylinder, 25 mm square-section bar), NOT an Np(Re) curve. Validity range: exactly these two Re; do not interpolate or extrapolate.
caveats: Np from bar torque (power balance); frozen rotor at one bar angle; equal-volume flat-bottom cylinder, not a round-bottom flask; wall functions on the bar
at 400 rpm the torque Np is non-monotone with refinement (1.25, 0.99, 0.90, 0.96), so GCI uses Fs = 3 with formal order 2 (14 %); the coarse triplet 4-6-9 alone would have claimed 5 % (misleading)
iteration convergence: <1 % over the last 100 SIMPLE iterations on the 9 and 13.5 cells/cm meshes, 1.1-1.4 % on the 4 and 6 meshes

points.Np_dissip_note: mean eps from kEpsilon + resolved gradients does not converge (rises 0.34 -> 0.45 -> 0.70 with refinement at 400 rpm); not used
